answer: Each new key is provisionally tagged at dawn and may settle only through a rotating trio of established brokers. After fourteen days the network cuts the settlement graph around those trades. If the applicant sits in a tight component with other provisional keys, that cluster is treated as a spent ember and every key in it is barred for a season. If the same trades instead bridge two previously separate broker neighborhoods, the key is promoted at the public wharf and may post unbrokered bids. Clone farms share counterparties, so they never form a bridge and never earn admission.
